# Reproducer: builtin modules depending on build-helper output

Two `Modules/Setup.local` builtin modules that cannot be built on `main`
because `Programs/_freeze_module` / `_bootstrap_python` link every static
module object:

* `_frozenuser`: includes a header generated by `$(FREEZE_MODULE)`
  (dependency cycle on `main`: "Circular ... dependency dropped").
* `_getpathuser`: references `_Py_Get_Getpath_CodeObject()` from
  `Modules/getpath.o` (fails to link `_freeze_module` once the stub in
  `Modules/getpath_noop.c` is gone).

To try it:

```sh
cp Tools/build/bootstrap-split-repro/_frozenuser.{c,py,mk} Modules/
cp Tools/build/bootstrap-split-repro/_getpathuser.c Modules/
cp Tools/build/bootstrap-split-repro/Setup.local <builddir>/Modules/Setup.local
make
./python -c 'import _frozenuser, _getpathuser; ns = {}; exec(_frozenuser.code(), ns); print(ns["greet"](), _getpathuser.getpath_code())'
```

`.DEFAULT_GOAL := all` in `_frozenuser.mk` is needed only because Setup
`include` lines land before the first target of the Makefile.
